hero.title: Surroundings and landscape
hero.subtitle: Campos de Montiel, Villamanrique, Iberian heritage and the most authentic La Mancha, a few kilometres from Torre de Juan Abad and Villanueva de los Infantes.

intro: Finca Los Collados de San Miguel is in Villamanrique, Ciudad Real, in Campos de Montiel (Castilla-La Mancha). It is a base for Villanueva de los Infantes, the Ruidera Lagoons, Valdepeñas and touring La Mancha. Book your stay and we will help you plan the visit.
distancesNote: Approximate driving distances from Villamanrique village (38.546 N, 2.998 W). Source: OSRM / OpenStreetMap, checked 19 Oct 2026. The last stretch to the estate is Unnamed Road.

distances.detail: Jaén 144 km · 2 h; Úbeda 100 km · 1 h 40 min

places.title: Campos de Montiel
places.description: A natural and historic region, a setting of legend and open country. Ideal for walking, birdwatching and a rural getaway.

places.title: Villamanrique
places.description: The nearest village to the estate. A starting point for discovering rural life in La Mancha and local cooking.

places.title: Torre de Juan Abad and around
places.description: A few kilometres away, in the same region. A cultural and gastronomic landmark of Castilla-La Mancha.

places.title: Villanueva de los Infantes
places.description: One of the most emblematic towns of La Mancha, tied to Cervantes and cultural tourism.

places.title: Iberian heritage and ruins
places.description: Remains of more than 2,500 years of history in the area: Iberians, Romans, Visigoths and Arabs.

places.title: Lagoons and nature
places.description: The region offers natural spaces, birdwatching routes and distinctive landscapes in which to switch off.

cta.title: Explore La Mancha from Los Collados
cta.text: Book your stay and we will help you plan routes through the territory.
